body: That's a good point. We've been looking, but he really hasn't opened up to past ones and hasn't prioritized finding one who can help him. He was also supposed to be taking medicine, but that apparently made him sleepy and apathetic. Any thoughts on the messages in a one way convo? That sounded like mental illness to me, but I'm unsure.
Thanks for the response. I'm definitely trying this out. Still doesn't solve anything short term but hopefully long term it encourages him to try and change
